passages.text: huc periture veni, capias ut digna Camillae

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.857
passages.text: praemia. Tune etiam telis moriere Dianae?

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.858
passages.text: dixit, et aurata volucrem Threissa sagittam

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.859
passages.text: deprompsit pharetra cornuque infensa tetendit

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.860
passages.text: et duxit longe, donec curvata coirent

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.861
passages.text: inter se capita et manibus iam tangeret aequis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.862
passages.text: laeva aciem ferri, dextra nervoque papillam.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.863
passages.text: Extemplo teli stridorem aurasque sonantis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.864
passages.text: audiit una Arruns, haesitque in corpore ferrum.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.865
passages.text: Illum exspirantem socii atque extrema gementem

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.866
passages.text: obliti ignoto camporum in pulvere linquunt,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.867
passages.text: Opis ad aetherium pennis aufertur Olympum.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.868
passages.text: Prima fugit domina amissa levis ala Camillae;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.869
passages.text: turbati fugiunt Rutuli, fugit acer Atinas

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.870
passages.text: disiectique duces desolatique manipli

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.871
passages.text: tuta petunt et equis aversi ad moenia tendunt.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.872
passages.text: Nec quisquam instantis Teucros letumque ferentis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.873
passages.text: sustentare valet telis aut sistere contra,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.874
passages.text: sed laxos referunt umeris languentibus arcus,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.875
passages.text: quadrupedumque putrem cursu quatit ungula campum.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.876
passages.text: Volvitur ad muros caligine turbidus atra

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.877
passages.text: pulvis, et e speculis percussae pectora matres

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.878
passages.text: femineum clamorem ad caeli sidera tollunt.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.879
passages.text: Qui cursu portas primi inrupere patentis,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.880
passages.text: hos inimica super mixto premit agmine turba;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.881
passages.text: nec miseram effugiunt mortem, sed limine in ipso,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.882
passages.text: moenibus in patriis atque inter tuta domorum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.883
passages.text: confixi exspirant animas. Pars claudere portas:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.884
passages.text: nec sociis aperire viam nec moenibus audent

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.885
passages.text: accipere orantis, oriturque miserrima caedes

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.886
passages.text: defendentum armis aditus inque arma ruentum.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.887
passages.text: Exclusi ante oculos lacrumantumque ora parentum

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.888
passages.text: pars in praecipitis fossas urgente ruina

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.889
passages.text: volvitur, immissis pars caeca et concita frenis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.890
passages.text: arietat in portas et duros obice postis.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.891
passages.text: Ipsae de muris summo certamine matres,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.892
passages.text: monstrat amor verus patriae, ut videre Camillam,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.893
passages.text: tela manu trepidae iaciunt ac robore duro

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.894
passages.text: stipitibus ferrum sudibusque imitantur obustis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.895
passages.text: praecipites primaeque mori pro moenibus ardent.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.896
passages.text: Interea Turnum in silvis saevissimus implet

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.897
passages.text: nuntius, et iuveni ingentem fert Acca tumultum:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.898
passages.text: deletas Volscorum acies, cecidisse Camillam,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.899
passages.text: ingruere infensos hostis et Marte secundo

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.900
passages.text: omnia corripuisse, metum iam ad moenia ferri.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.901
passages.text: Ille furens, et saeva Iovis sic numina pellunt,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.902
passages.text: deserit obsessos collis, nemora aspera linquit.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.903
passages.text: Vix e conspectu exierat campumque tenebat,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.904
passages.text: cum pater Aeneas saltus ingressus apertos

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.905
passages.text: exsuperatque iugum silvaque evadit opaca.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.906
passages.text: Sic ambo ad muros rapidi totoque feruntur

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.907
passages.text: agmine nec longis inter se passibus absunt;

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.908
passages.text: ac simul Aeneas fumantis pulvere campos

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.909
passages.text: prospexit longe Laurentiaque agmina vidit,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.910
passages.text: et saevum Aenean adgnovit Turnus in armis

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.911
passages.text: adventumque pedum flatusque audivit equorum.

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.912
passages.text: Continuoque ineant pugnas et proelia temptent,

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.913
passages.text: ni roseus fessos iam gurgite Phoebus Hibero

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.914
passages.text: tinguat equos noctemque die labente reducat:

passages.label: Verg. Aen. 11.915
passages.text: considunt castris ante urbem et moenia vallant.
